name: canonic.digamma
title: Canonical parameter for the Digamma family

origin.description: Inverse of meanval.digamma: the canonical parameter as a function of the mean.

arguments.name: mu
arguments.text: Numeric vector of positive fitted values.

origin.details: This mapping inverts the Digamma mean function meanval.digamma. The iteration starts from theta = -1/mu and takes three Newton steps on the log scale using meanval.digamma and d2cumulant.digamma.
origin.value: Numeric vector of canonical parameters theta, equal to -1/phi where phi is the gamma dispersion parameter.

translation.description: Inverse of meanval.digamma: the canonical parameter as a function of the mean.

arguments.name: mu
arguments.text: Numeric vector of positive fitted values.

translation.details: This mapping inverts the Digamma mean function meanval.digamma. The iteration starts from theta = -1/mu and takes three Newton steps on the log scale using meanval.digamma and d2cumulant.digamma.
translation.value: NumPy array of canonical parameters theta, equal to -1/phi where phi is the gamma dispersion parameter.
translation.example:
import numpy as np
from statmod.canonic_digamma import canonic_digamma

mu = np.array([0.5, 1, 2])
print(canonic_digamma(mu))
